entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unnecessary sign-extension for `LeadingZeroCount(UInt64)` #119699
  • Cannot unload assembly because a reference is stored in System.Dynamic.Utils.TypeExtensions.s_paramInfoCache._entries #119697
  • JIT: Bounds check not hoisted or eliminated for simple InlineArray iteration #119693
  • Crash on startup on Android with UseMonoRuntime false using Sentry and Avalonia #119692
  • Simplify `Span.Slice(int, int)` bounds check for improved x64 codegen #119689

Closed

  • Add workload for embeddable MonoVM #46994
    Future
  • StackFrameIterator triggers assertion when unwinding past __managed__Main in try-catch test #119687
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: Add `TrySingle<TSource>(IEnumerable<TSource>, Func<TSource, bool> predicate, out TSource)` #119688

PullRequests

Created

  • [clr-interp] fix stack maps #119696
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • [mono][metadata] Enable compressed interface bitmap by default #119694
    area-VM-meta-mono
  • Change RhpGcAlloc size argument type to intptr_t for consistency #119691
    area-VM-coreclr

Updated

  • Signature parsing and GetFieldDescData cDAC API #119417
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [release/10.0] Revert "JIT: Remove side effect detection quirk in loop hoisting (#118463)" with some improvements #119346
    Servicing-approved, area-CodeGen-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • Annotate `System.Speech` for nullable reference types #119564
    area-System.Speech, community-contribution
  • Adding GetCodeHeaderData cDAC API #119609
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Move the implementation of Monitor to managed in CoreCLR #118371
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, 11.0.0
  • [cDAC] implement IXCLRDataMethodInstance::GetName and associated APIs #118966
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [host] Prevent swift backtrace handler from firing when the runtime aborts on OSX #119429
    area-Host
  • Refactor ValueStringBuilder #119599
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • [release/10.0] [EventPipe][UserEvents] Allow empty tracepoint sets #119666
    Servicing-approved, area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • [release/10.0] [DAC] Properly dereference `internal_root_array` #119496
    Servicing-approved, area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • [release/10.0] Allow disabling runtime versions via an environment variable #119518
    Servicing-approved, area-Host, 10.0.0
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #119679
    area-codeflow
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #119678
    area-codeflow
  • Polyfill SearchValues and optimize Activity, W3CPropagator #119673
    area-Meta, linkable-framework, 11.0.0
